description: This file defines the 'HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tables' class, which configures the HTML Purifier library to handle XHTML 1.1 table elements, including their attributes and permissible child elements.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tables
classes.description: A class that sets up the configuration for accessible XHTML 1.1 table elements, including elements like table, caption, tr, td, th, col, colgroup, tbody, thead, and tfoot, along with their specific attributes and attributes groups.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures the table-related elements and attributes for the HTML purifier, adding definitions for table structure, attributes, and child elements.
